title: WHO-recommended handrub formulations
author: WHO
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdqei5te

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol-based Handrub (10 L)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 L formulation using a glass or plastic bottle with a screw-threaded stopper.

substeps.instruction: Pour 8333 mL of 96% Ethanol into the bottle or tank up to the graduated mark.
Add 417 mL of 3% Hydrogen peroxide using a measuring cylinder.
Add 145 mL of Glycerol using a measuring cylinder; rinse the cylinder with sterile distilled or cold boiled water and empty the rinsate into the bottle/tank.
Top the bottle/tank up to the 10-liter mark with sterile distilled or cold boiled water.
Place the lid or screw cap on the bottle immediately to prevent evaporation.
Mix the solution by shaking gently or using a paddle.
Divide the solution immediately into final containers (e.g., 500 or 100 mL plastic bottles).
Place the bottles in quarantine for 72 hours before use to destroy any spores.
